name: Dish with Dragons, Pomegranates, and Peaches
material: Porcelain with incised and enamel decoration, susancai ware
summary: Various techniques are applied to the decoration of susancai or "plain three-color" ware. The hidden dragons are incised, over which are painted decoration of fruit and flower sprays outlined with black pigment and colored with yellow, green, turquoise, and purplish brown enamels.
